messages:
kevin: RC merged into release/v1.9.0 — build artifacts uploaded. Targeting 16:00 UTC announce to #announcements unless we see a blocker. Can folks call out anything that should hold the announce?

maria: quick note — e2e smoke yesterday showed a flaky embeddings endpoint in canary (timeout spike). Reproduced twice.

nina: I saw that in CI too, looks like a retry loop exposed under high batch sizes. Filed a small fix in PR #4127 — requesting review.

kevin: @nina thanks. Is that safe to backport to the RC branch? If yes we can cut a patch and ship before announce.

nina: yep, tiny change. I'll open a hotfix branch off release/v1.9.0 and ping @sam for quick review.

sam: on it, can review in next 30. If green we can merge and rebuild.

linda: changelog check: we need to add the new cost-metering flag and note the dedupe fix. I have a one-liner entry ready.

kevin: great. If we can get hotfix merged by 14:30 UTC, we can run a fresh canary pass and still hit announce at 16:00. Otherwise we push announce to 18:00 and run a longer canary. Anyone object to that plan?

maria: 14:30 sounds tight but ok if tests are green. Otherwise prefer 18:00 to avoid a noisy rollback during business hours for EU customers.

sam: review done, approved. @nina you can merge after CI.

release-bot: Build pipeline started for release/v1.9.0-hotfix. Job ID: 88423.

opsbot: Canary rollout scheduled: 10% traffic -> 30% -> 100% with 10m waits. Health checks enabled.

nina: merged and pushed. CI passed. Hotfix tag: v1.9.1-rc1.

kevin: nice. Linda, can you drop the changelog entry into the release notes? Also bump the public version string to 1.9.1 in package manifest.

linda: done. Changelog snippet added and PR to update manifest opened: #4132.

maria: I'll start a quick smoke local run against the canary and report back in ~10.

kevin: timeline update — canary pass expected done by 15:20 UTC. If all good we'll post announce at 16:00. If flaky appears again we'll delay to 18:00 and notify #announcements with a slip notice.

maria: smoke looks good so far. No timeouts at 5k token workload.

sam: load tests stable. Observability shows slightly higher p99 on embed route but within SLO.

kevin: ok proceed with rolling the canary to 30%. Opsbot, begin next step when ready.

opsbot: Canary traffic increased to 30%. Monitoring alerts will escalate on error rate >1% or latency >1200ms.

maria: monitoring green during 30% window. No new errors.

kevin: rolling to 100% now. After roll completes I'll post draft announce copy here for final sign-off.

release-bot: Canary rollout complete. All checks passed. Deployed tag: v1.9.1.

kevin: announce copy (draft):

```
Heads up — we've released Redwood Inference v1.9.1 with improvements to embeddings stability, a new cost-metering flag, and several reliability fixes. No breaking changes. See release notes: <link>
```

kevin: Quick thumbs? :thumbsup: means go live. :thumbsdown: means hold and list reason.

maria: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup: small nit: mention the minor version bump in subject.

linda: :thumbsup: changelog link looks good.

nina: :thumbsup: good to go.

kevin: posting to #announcements in 5.

release-bot: Posted announcement to #announcements at 16:03 UTC. Message ID: 99211.
